title: OLA unique RDM LIST_INTERFACES response
problem: Multiple addresses for one OS network interface can make OLA return the same interface index more than once in the E1.37-7 LIST_INTERFACES response.
reproduce: Supply interface records with indices 3, 7 and 3, then request LIST_INTERFACES; the unpatched response contains three entries instead of two.
acceptance: The response contains each interface index once, remains ordered by index, preserves the interface type, and the dedicated OLA regression test passes.
repair: Sort network interfaces and erase adjacent records whose OS interface indices match before counting and packing the RDM response.

verification.limitations: BCL compiles the response-ordering model and verifies the patched production and regression-test contracts. OLA's full ResponderHelperTester passed separately in clean Debian; the offline case does not rebuild all of OLA or query host interfaces.
verification.ownerCheck: Run an RDMnet controller against an OLA host whose interface discovery returns multiple addresses for one NIC. Request LIST_INTERFACES and confirm every OS interface index appears once with the expected hardware type. Record OLA revision, OS and interface configuration.
